Alpha Vantage API Documentation

Time Series Data

This category provides access to real-time and historical time series data for stocks, ETFs, and digital currencies. All data is delivered in JSON format and includes intraday, daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.

TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY

Get intraday time series data for a specific stock symbol.

Fundamental Data

Access comprehensive fundamental data including company overview, income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements for publicly traded companies.

OVERVIEW

Get company overview information including market cap, P/E ratio, and dividend yield.

Technical Indicators

Calculate various technical indicators using historical price data. These indicators help in technical analysis and trading strategy development.

SMA

Calculate Simple Moving Average for a given symbol and time period.
